exposure: institutional investment in an LOS reduction program
development of rigorous internal LOS data analytics
multiple Diagnosis Related Group (DRG)-focused LOS reduction initiatives (sepsis, obstetric, and psychiatric DRGs)
cohort: Patients admitted to an urban academic safety-net hospital for various conditions, including sepsis, obstetric, and psychiatric Diagnosis Related Groups (DRGs).
finding: A multifaceted quality improvement initiative at a safety-net hospital significantly improved mean Length of Stay Index (LOSI) and demonstrated a delayed but statistically significant improvement in Length of Stay (LOS), with sustained performance and no adverse effects on readmissions or mortality.
